questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. 

**Statements: **

No potatoes is sweet.

All potatoes are avocadoes.

Some potatoes are dragon fruits.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some avocadoes are not sweets.

II. Some dragon fruits are not sweets.

III. Some avocadoes are sweets.

options.text: Both conclusion II and III follow.
Both conclusion I and II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e7591cb16dd13fa9e048a71b27944a412c6cf23a07fc54380ddb7d4a3d64e92.png] 

 

Conclusions:

I. Some avocadoes are not sweets → Follow (As no potatoes is sweet and all potatoes are avocadoes. As whole potatoes comes in avocadoes and cannot be sweet, therefore it is true)

II. Some dragon fruits are not sweets → Follow (As no potatoes is sweet and some potatoes are dragon fruits. As some part of dragon fruit is common with potatoes which whole comes in avocadoes and cannot be sweet, therefore it is true.)

III. Some avocadoes are sweets → Does not follow (As no potatoes is sweet and all potatoes are avocadoes. So it is possible but not definite)

∴ Here, Both conclusion I and II follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"

questions.question: D, E, K, W, X, Y and Z scored different marks in an exam. K scored more than only two people. E scored less than only one person. W scored more than D but less than both E and Z. D did not score the lowest marks and Z did not score the highest marks. X scored less than Y. How many people scored more than Y?
questions.solution:
**Given:** D, E, K, W, X, Y and Z scored different marks in an exam. 

1) K scored more than only two people. 

2) E scored less than only one person.

_ > E > _ > _ > K > _ > _

3) W scored more than D but less than both E and Z.

4) D did not score the lowest marks and Z did not score the highest marks.

_ > E > Z > W > K > D > _

5) X scored less than Y. 

Y > E > Z > W > K > D > X

Thus, according to the final arrangement, no person scored more than Y.

Hence,** "Option 3"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: Ramesh wants to visit his childhood friend's house. Ramesh's friend explained his house directions over a text message. See the below text sent to Ramesh about the direction of his friend's house and answer the following question accordingly. "When you step out of your house, you are facing north. Take a right and walk 3 km, you will see a T-point/junction. Take a right and walk 2 km. There will be a roundabout with four roads. Take the second left from the roundabout and walk 1 km. Take a right and walk 3 km. Take a right and walk 1 km. You will find my house at the front." How many kilometres did Ramesh walk till the roundabout?
questions.solution:
Given: Ramesh wants to visit his childhood friend’s house. Ramesh’s friend explained his house directions over a text message.

When you step out of your house, you are facing north.

Take a right and walk 3 km, you will see a T-point/junction.

Take a right and walk 2 km. There will be a roundabout with four roads. 

Take the second left from the roundabout and walk 1 km. 

Take a right and walk 3 km. 

Take a right and walk 1 km. You will find my house at the front.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec061df6732ac9af7281ec1be1623a811362e55cc118decca5a62c796b123fcf.png] 

Thus, Ramesh walked (3 km + 2 km) 5 km till the roundabout.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Here, specifically "Roundabout" is mentioned, so accordingly counting clockwise from the roundabout - 2nd left will be in the south direction.

Furthermore, it is also mentioned "There will be a roundabout with four roads.", so 4 roads are of the four direction, therefore at the roundabout when counted clockwise:

Ramesh (Facing south) → 1st road

1st left (east) → 2nd road

2nd left (south) → 3rd road

3rd left (west) → 4th road

∴ Here, Only conclusion (1) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"
